caption: A pair of hands held in a flashlight beam pointed at a wall forms a bird shape, and a bird-shaped shadow appears on the wall.

sa.check: A pair of hands is held in a flashlight beam pointed at a wall.
The hands form a bird shape.
A bird-shaped shadow appears on the wall.
The hands are shaped first and the shadow appears with them.

pc.expect: The shadow matches the outline of the hands and changes the instant the fingers move.
pc.fail: The shadow is a different shape from the hands; or it stays fixed while the fingers move; or it changes while the hands are still.

pc.expect: The shadow appears only where the beam hits the wall, on the far side of the hands from the flashlight.
pc.fail: It appears outside the lit patch; or between the hands and the flashlight; or with the flashlight off.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It drifts across the wall with the hands still; or it flaps by itself; or it moves before the hands.

pc.expect: The shadow is one connected dark shape, larger than the hands, with a soft edge.
pc.fail: It splits into pieces unrelated to the fingers; or it is smaller than the hands; or it has a hard geometric outline unlike the hands.

pc.expect: Two hands and one shadow; the hands keep their fingers and nothing passes through the wall.
pc.fail: A finger vanishes or an extra appears; or a second shadow appears under one beam; or the hands pass through the wall; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wall and the flashlight stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The wall changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the flashlight changes.

note: The hands are the object casting the shadow; the person is not judged.
